description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_InternshipOffer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfferAcceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">

  </bpmn:collaboration>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_You" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue"/>

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny the offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteWeeklyUpdates" name="Write weekly status updates about the internship (at least 3)">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">weekly updates written < 3</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishInternship" name="Finish the internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Recommend" name="Recommend the company to friends?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send a separate recommendation tweet to each friend via Twitter">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Recommended" name="Company recommended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRecommended" name="Internship finished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_You" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_3" name="Enter additional details" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_4" name="Skip additional details" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_6" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_7" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_8" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_9" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_10" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_12" sourceRef="Task_WriteWeeklyUpdates" targetRef="Task_FinishInternship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_13" sourceRef="Task_FinishInternship" targetRef="Gateway_Recommend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_14" name="Recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_15" name="Do not recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRecommended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_16" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="EndEvent_Recommended"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company internship activities" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Company" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffers" name="Send internship offers" messageRef="Message_InternshipOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about you">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">3</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Company" name="Company status updates written"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Company" targetRef="Task_SendOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" targetRef="EndEvent_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
